title: dev.qory.run.refused
description: The run did not start after the ping. Emitted in place of dev.qory.run.started, the run's first event after the ping, heartbeats aside, and its last, by the session, in two cases. The server closes the run before it starts, with a 410 run_closed in its signed answer: the session records it in the file sink alone. A gateway refuses the session's run request, with a code in its answer on the link, unsigned and authenticated by the transport: the session records the refusal it received, its code and names, in its file record and on the link, and the gateway delivers the session's events. Events carry names and ids alone, and no value but the run credential's own in a gateway's refusal that names one.

code.description: Why the run did not start: a refusal code of Forager, of qory, of the server, or of a gateway that verifies a run credential, the one the refusal's body contained: the server's in its signed answer, a gateway's in its answer on the link, unsigned. The enum is the list of refusal codes Forager, qory, the server and a gateway share; the session writes run_closed for the server's close, and the code of a gateway's refusal it received.

names.description: The names the refusal concerns: variables, tools, images, paths, an earlier or another run's id, or the names a server's or a gateway's coded refusal lists. A name never carries a value, except the run credential's own value in target_differs_from_credential and differs_from_credential: there each name is <member>=<value>, the member the session sent, labels.<key> or about.details.<key>, then = and the value the run credential holds, such as labels.forge=example-forge.

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer, when the code came from the server.
